name: roller seated single leg shoulder flexor depresor retractor
description: A seated single-leg roller drill for shoulder control. Helps with shoulder mobility and posture.
instructions: Sit on the floor with a foam roller under the calf of one straight leg and the other foot flat.
Place your hands on the floor behind your hips, arms straight.
Press down through your hands, drawing your shoulders down and back, and lift your hips slightly.
Move your body forward and back so the roller travels along the calf.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch legs.
